text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You were so close, Tickezo! But that was
a great
race!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was so awesome! Good luck
next time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I... I made it all the way to the Derby...
But I
failed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: AAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it! This is the wooorst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race of Winning Ticket's dreams, the

Japanese Derby, ends not with a bang,
but with a
whimper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she can't stop crying, and
I try to
console her on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I feel a little better. Thanks,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always been quick to tears, but
I've never
seen her this sad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But just as I'm wondering how I can
cheer her up...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I know what those two would say if they
were
here. They'd tell me, "You can't cry
forever."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Now that I've gotten that out of
my
system, I've realized something.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even though I lost, my fans said it was a
great
race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Winning... isn't the only thing that's
important.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's the serious competition, the huge
clash
between rivals that makes a race so
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a little sniffle, Winning Ticket tries
to give
me a happy smile.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it like that, I was still
able to give
them an exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks!
choice_data_list: 間違いなく最高のレースだったぞ！
間違いなく最高のレースだったよ！

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, the next goal is the Kikuka
Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That one has to be a great race too! I'm
gonna
make sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though her dream of winning the
Derby
didn't come true, Winning Ticket
beams with the
satisfaction of having
excited the crowd.
